system_and_unit: Synapsin-Cre Wwox neocortical L2/3 slices P13-P17; animals are the unit, slices nested; at least 6 animals per genotype
readouts: isolated NMDAR current (amplitude, decay, GluN2B sensitivity); sIPSC amplitude, frequency AND charge with physiological internal chloride; Vm and Rin; XE991-sensitive current
prediction_fixed_before: HT sIPSC charge at least 80 percent of WT, KO at most 55 percent; NMDAR current in KO not raised more than 25 percent over WT
what_would_change: if HT inhibition is reduced like KO, Q-inh loses KO specificity (pre-registered P-iv); if NMDAR current is raised, Q-NMDAR leads
controls: same internal solution and temperature across genotypes; blind to genotype; recording order balanced

system_and_unit: same slices and preparation, WT and HT
genotype_or_manipulation: manipulations applied singly: (i) gabazine titrated to the KO-measured IPSC charge fraction; (ii) bath K+ raised to depolarise by the KO-measured 5.6 mV; (iii) Mg2+ lowered only to match the KO NMDAR current if E0 shows it raised
agent_and_role: gabazine (T1), K+ (T1); d-AP5 as last step
readouts: burst incidence per arm (slices, with animals as units), d-APV sensitivity of any burst
prediction_fixed_before: (i) yields d-APV-sensitive bursts in at least 2 times the fraction of (ii); at least 12 slices from at least 6 animals per arm (power about 0.9 for 0.8 v 0.17; clustering lowers it)
what_would_change: if (ii) matches (i): intrinsic sufficiency; if neither: interaction or secondary state; if only (iii): NMDAR gain
controls: TTX confirms activity-driven events; vehicle arm; the HT slices tested with and without (i)

system_and_unit: S-KO slices (bursting), one slice per animal per condition where possible
genotype_or_manipulation: single-mechanism corrections titrated to restore the control value of the targeted quantity: IPSC charge (H1 or A1), Vm (D1)
agent_and_role: clobazam with N-desmethylclobazam; tiagabine; ezogabine with XE991 reversal; GluN2B NAM radiprodil as the NMDAR-rival arm; d-AP5 last
readouts: burst frequency, duration, amplitude; IPSC charge, Vm, NMDAR current at the concentration used (verified in the same slice)
prediction_fixed_before: restoring IPSC charge stops at least 50 percent of KO burst frequency; restoring Vm alone does not; the effect of each agent on WT matched-trigger bursts is at most half its effect on KO
what_would_change: if Vm restoration also stops bursts, intrinsic and inhibitory deficits are both sufficient-correctable (no single step); if no single arm works, interaction or secondary state
controls: suppression index (effect in WT matched-trigger slices); F-I curve, Rin, AP height and viability; washout; evoked fEPSP slope; no layer-marker or persistence requirement

system_and_unit: S-KO and S-WT slices matched for animal weight, glycaemia (measured) and myelination state where available
prediction_fixed_before: burst incidence not explained by weight or glycaemia within genotype
what_would_change: if explained, bursting is secondary to systemic state and every pharmacological arm is symptomatic
controls: record age, weight and glucose per animal
